shots.summary: Wide establishing shot inside the Marina del Rey curved-glass studio at rainy dusk. 11 machined-aluminum blades glow cool cyan, while Blade #04 burns crimson-orange at 100% CPU overload, venting steam. Architect sits at the cantilevered aluminum desk on the right.

nano_banana_pro.environment: Environment A — Warm California Oceanfront Penthouse (Marina del Rey)
nano_banana_pro.prompt: Photorealistic live-action 65mm cinema wide establishing shot inside a warm, luxurious lived-in California modern oceanfront penthouse living room in Marina del Rey at sunset twilight. Absolutely zero concrete walls, no industrial brutality. Wide-plank honey European oak hardwood floors, warm cedar-slat wood ceiling with subtle warm recessed lighting, a cozy cream boucle sofa with warm throw pillows, a low travertine stone fireplace with a soft flickering flame, a potted indoor Mediterranean olive tree, open floating shelves with architectural art books, and a warm mid-century brass floor lamp. Fully open floor-to-ceiling motorized sliding glass doors lead onto an expansive teak wood balcony deck with seamless glass railings overlooking an unobstructed, breathtaking panoramic vista of the Marina del Rey harbor water, luxury yacht masts, coastal palm trees, and the Pacific Ocean horizon under a golden-hour violet-rose sunset sky. On the right, at a custom live-edge American walnut and brushed-aluminum executive desk with a frameless 32-inch Apple Pro Display XDR monitor, sits the 38-year-old systems architect (#01 Alexei from the reference portrait: short dark hair, sharp jawline, light 3-day stubble, wearing a fitted dark charcoal merino crewneck sweater).
